content: This document serves as a detailed guide for coaches on how to effectively engage with new scholars. Coaches are expected to follow the outlined steps in the exact order provided below: 1. Creating a User Account To create or confirm a user account, administrative user rights are required. If you need to confirm a request for a user account, click the designated link provided. If you need to create a new user account, click the appropriate link provided. 2. Creating a User Template A user template is a computer program designed to generate identical content across multiple pages. To create a user template, start by creating a new page and type template:xyz (where xyz can be the name or initials of the scholar). For example, John Smith’s user template could be named template:JS, template:JSmith, template:JohnSmith, or template:JSM. Once the template page is created, go to the page, type ], and save the page. Record the name of the saved page and share it with the respective scholar. 3. Creating a User Sandbox The WikiDoc sandbox is a designated space for practicing basic editing commands. It is recommended that the sandbox be used in conjunction with training on basic editing skills. To create a user sandbox, create a new page and type sandbox:xyz (where xyz can be the name or initials of the scholar). For instance, John Smith’s sandbox could be named sandbox:JS, sandbox:JSmith, sandbox:JohnSmith, or sandbox:JSM. Record the name of the saved sandbox page and share it with the respective scholar. 4. Assistance and Compliance Check After completing the above steps, coaches should periodically monitor the progress of their assigned scholars. This can be done by reviewing the individual user sandbox or by directly asking the scholar if they require any assistance. It is essential to address any concerns or questions the scholars may have as they familiarize themselves with the layout and organization of WikiDoc projects. 5. Communication As with any team-based project, being part of the WikiDoc team requires adherence to the rules and norms of teamwork. Effective communication is critical to ensuring that scholars feel comfortable and supported. Timely and efficient communication helps address scholars’ questions and concerns appropriately. Every scholar is a beginner, and since every beginner has the potential to become a master in their field, it is vital to acknowledge and appreciate their efforts.
